in_marathi.name: Devavrata
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devavrata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devavrata means 'God-bound' or 'God-pledged'. In Hindu mythology, Devavrata is the name of a character who took a vow to God and lived up to it, leading a life of devotion and righteousness.
